content: Hi! How can I help you today? Are you looking to share or organize your old family scans?
Yes, I have a folder of high-res scans from my grandparents' albums. The files are huge and I want to share them without losing quality.

That sounds wonderful, what a special project! To keep everything safe and private, I recommend uploading your scans to a cloud folder and setting it to view-only. This keeps your originals intact and lets family browse or download what they need.
Should I share the folder with everyone at once? And what about the file names?

Great questions! For privacy, it's best to only invite those who you'd like to access the scans. Also, naming files with dates or short descriptions, like '1952_Reunion.jpg', makes things easier to sort. After sharing, your family can click into the folder to browse the collection.
Okay, I'll organize the photos and upload them. Can I set the link to expire after a week?
Absolutely, setting an expiration date is a smart privacy move. Most cloud services let you set links to expire, or you can remove access after everyone has had a chance to download their favorites.
Some photos include friends or neighbors, should I ask before sharing those?
That's very considerate! It's always best to get consent before sharing images of others, even in old photos. Maybe send a quick note asking if they'd be comfortable with you including those scans.
Thanks. I've finished uploading. Here's the link: <FamilyScans2024>. What should I tell everyone to do?

Perfect! When you share the link, let your family know they can click to open the folder, browse through the scans, and download any originals they'd like to keep. Remind them the link is view-only and will expire in a week for everyone's privacy.
Should I add a note about the file size? Some files are pretty big.
Yes, that's helpful! You can mention that the original scans are high-res and may take a moment to download. Suggest downloading over Wi-Fi for best results.
Got it. I'll email everyone with the link, instructions, and a reminder about the expiration.

Wonderful! If anyone needs help, invite them to visit the folder and reach out with questions. You can also direct them to the sharing settings page if they want to double-check the privacy details. What a thoughtful way to preserve your family's memories!
